title: Speech brought back to the Lord’s Door
subtitle: For the day when words keep steering the heart
description: These readings follow speech back to appetite, anger, slander, and truth, then place the tongue under the question of honor.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The shabad asks what words bring honor before the Lord, after naming what degrades the mouth.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Make each sentence answer to truth rather than to heat.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey reforms speech by making it accountable before the Lord’s Door.
evidence.turn: The tongue is freed when it stops serving the hungers that dirty it.
evidence.practicalImplication: Practice one day of fewer, cleaner words.
